description: The committed IPC command allowlist. CI fails when the tauri-specta generated bindings expose a command set different from this list. Additions are deliberate contract changes, never side effects.

notes.note_write: Contract addition per design decision 100: change-set based writes verified against the expected projection hash, with a conflict variant carrying the current hash and a reconciliation handle, never a silent overwrite.
notes.vault_tree_refresh: Contract addition per design decision 100: on-demand re-index of the vault tree from current filesystem state, the recovery path for tree staleness after external bulk changes or watcher overflow.
notes.search_query: Contract addition per design decision 100: ranked snippeted full-text search (the decision 79 alpha floor). The index lives in the OS app-data directory, never in the vault; match positions are byte ranges into the snippet so highlighting needs no HTML injection.
notes.settings_read: Contract addition per design decision 100: reads settings.json from the OS app-config directory per the architecture contract (schema_version, typed known keys, defaults when absent).
notes.settings_write: Contract addition per design decision 100: whole-document settings write with validation; unknown keys already in the file are preserved internally.
notes.vault_config_read: Contract addition per design decision 100: read-only access to the recognized Obsidian configuration files (app.json, types.json) in the vault's .obsidian directory, the single sanctioned read path into an otherwise excluded directory; absent or malformed files degrade to defaults.
notes.vault_file_read: Read-only access to indexed regular files for registered render-only views. The command never creates note editing, reconciliation, or search-index state.
